What is the approximate difference in the aggregate percentages of P and Q?
solution:
**Given:**

Marks obtained by Student P: Physics = 50, Chemistry = 85, Biology = 55, Hindi = 40

Maximum Marks for Student P: Physics = 100, Chemistry = 100, Biology = 100, Hindi = 50

Marks obtained by Student Q: Physics = 65, Chemistry = 90, Biology = 50, Hindi = 45

Maximum Marks for Student Q: Physics = 100, Chemistry = 100, Biology = 100, Hindi = 50

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Total Marks Obtained ÷ Total Maximum Marks) × 100

**Calculation:**

For Student P:

Total Marks Obtained = 50 + 85 + 55 + 40 = 230

Total Maximum Marks = 100 + 100 + 100 + 50 = 350

⇒ Percentage of P = (230 ÷ 350) × 100 = 65.71%

For Student Q:

Total Marks Obtained = 65 + 90 + 50 + 45 = 250

Total Maximum Marks = 100 + 100 + 100 + 50 = 350

⇒ Percentage of Q = (250 ÷ 350) × 100 = 71.43%

Difference in Percentage = 71.43% - 65.71% ≈ 6%

**∴ The approximate difference in the aggregate percentages of P and Q is 6%.**
